deploy-bot: Preflight eval failed for release v0.24.1 — canary (5%) shows regression on 'answer_clarity' (-3.7% vs baseline) and spike in hallucination_rate (+1.5%). Canary hold automatically applied. Details: https://ci.redwood/internals/evals/9876 :warning:
preflight-bot: failing prompt sets: 'billing-flow' (7/50 regressions), 'faq' (3/20). Config: canary=5% / monitoring window=30m.
jess (PM): Thanks — that matches the customer reports we started getting this morning. We should triage before deciding rollback. Can someone run a bisect on the prompt set?
ryan (eng): I'll kick off prompt-bisect now. ETA ~20m. If it's a model tweak, plan is to pin canary to the previous model rev and freeze rollout.
sam (QA): I can reproduce locally with seed=42, attaching failing prompts in a follow-up.
nana (eng-oncall): Important: change window opens 11:00 UTC. If we need urgent rollback before that, follow manual rollback runbook. Who will own rollback if we need it?
ryan (eng): I'll own rollback. Proposed plan: pin canary to model `open-llama-v2-13b@rev-2026-03-12`. Command I'll run:```
redwoodctl rollout pin --model open-llama-v2-13b --rev 2026-03-12 --scope canary
```Monitor for 30m, then decide.
jess (PM): Decision rules: if answer_clarity loss >2% across core prompt set keep freeze & schedule hotfix. If hallucination_rate >1% absolute increase => rollback required. Everyone ok with those thresholds?
sam (QA): Agree. I'll run the post-pin regression eval as soon as pin is done and post results. Uploading failing prompts now.
ryan (eng): Bisect done: probable culprit change is commit `cc9b3` (prompt-normalization tuning) that landed in v0.24.1. Repro triggers on 'billing-flow' prompts.
jess (PM): Good find. Please open a revert PR for that change and add an eval test to catch it. Link the PR here when ready.
nana (eng-oncall): Given customer impact, we should pin canary immediately to limit exposure. @ryan please run the pin and post rollout id.
ryan (eng): Running pin now...
deploy-bot: rollout job started: id=rollout-2026-18765; action=pin; target=canary; model=open-llama-v2-13b; rev=2026-03-12
deploy-bot: rollout status: canary pinned successfully :thumbsup: — monitoring metrics for 30m.
preflight-bot: post-pin quick-check: answer_clarity delta now -0.4% (within threshold), hallucination_rate +0.2% — PASS for hold-exit criteria.
jess (PM): Good. Do we unfreeze the RC or keep freeze until revert/hotfix?
ryan (eng): Keep the freeze. I'll open the revert PR and run a full eval. If the full eval after revert passes, we'll unfreeze and promote. PR: https://repo.redwood/PR/789 (revert prompt-normalization).
sam (QA): I'll schedule the full eval in the morning batch and report back here with results. cc: @ana
ana (eng-oncall): Updated incident tracker: https://inc.redwood/1953. Owners: ryan (rollback/pin), sam (QA), jess (PM).
jess (PM): Please also prepare a brief release note for ops:
"v0.24.1 held: prompt-normalization tuning caused regression on billing prompts; canary pinned to rev 2026-03-12. Hotfix PR opened."
ryan (eng): Drafted release note and linked PR above. Ping for reviews.
deploy-bot: reminder: change window at 11:00 UTC — any non-emergency ops must be coordinated with oncall.
jess (PM): I'll close this thread and will update when hotfix merged or when we unfreeze the release. :white_check_mark:
